name: How long does a whole house renovation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a whole house renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a whole house renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope, the home's size, and the complexity of the desired changes. Minor renovations might take a few months, while extensive overhauls involving structural work, multiple room additions, or significant layout changes can extend to six months or even over a year. Factors like material lead times, permit approvals, and unexpected discoveries during demolition also influence the timeline. A detailed project schedule will be provided after initial planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies but can range from a few months for minor renovations to over a year for extensive overhauls, depending on scope and complexity.
